items.title: Joe Burrow: Six total TDs in wild win
items.text:
Burrow completed 38 of 48 passes for 462 yards with five touchdowns and three interceptions and added three carries for 10 yards and another score in the Bengals' 43-36 overtime win over the Titans on Sunday.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Will have surgery and go on IR
items.text:
Jackson is slated to have surgery to address his right thumb injury and will be placed on injured reserve, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Four total TDs in Week 8 win
items.text:
Cousins completed 19 of 26 passes for 247 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets. He added five rushing attempts for three yards and a rushing touchdown.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Scores twice in Week 8 win
items.text:
Bowers caught seven of 10 targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Gets two carries to Washington's 25
items.text:
Jeanty rushed twice for nine yards while catching three of four targets for 64 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.
